entities.summary: Eugene Edward Campbell was an American ice hockey player. He played for the Minnesota Golden Gophers. He won a silver medal with the United States national team at the 1956 Winter Olympics. He was born in Minneapolis, Minnesota and died at Lake Minnetonka Shores in Spring Park, Minnesota.
